breakfast.shake: a blended protein shake or smoothie, drunk not eaten
breakfast.yoghurt_nuts_seeds: plain unsweetened yoghurt with nuts, seeds and optional berries
breakfast.fish: an oily-fish breakfast (smoked salmon, sardines, mackerel, kippers)
breakfast.baked_beans: beans as the base (baked beans, white beans, black beans), served hot
breakfast.eggs: an egg-based cooked breakfast (omelette, scramble, frittata, shakshuka, boiled)

lunch.salad: a substantial cold salad with a protein on top
lunch.soup: a hearty soup or broth, reheatable
lunch.wrap: a wrap, flatbread or hand-held roll
lunch.grain_bowl: a warm grain or legume bowl with protein and vegetables
lunch.cold_plate: a no-cook cold plate: cured/cooked protein, cheese, raw veg, dips

dinner.one_pan: a single tray-bake or one-pan meal
dinner.curry: a simmered curry or stew in sauce, served with a side
dinner.grill: grilled or pan-seared protein with cooked vegetable sides
dinner.roast: a roasted joint or whole bird with roasted vegetables
dinner.braise: a slow-braised pot dish that improves after resting

snack.nuts_seeds: a portion of nuts and seeds
snack.fruit_and_protein: fruit paired with a protein source
